answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the yarrow queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 635 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the thread. The dune index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 185 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
